0.description:
Fill and outline colour: `#hex`, a CSS colour name, or `rgb()`/`hsl()` notation.
Default: each feature its own colour from a fixed palette.
Outline colour, as for `color`. Default the fill colour.
Fill opacity, 0 (transparent) to 1 (opaque). Default 0.45 for sections.

2.description: Dot-separated path into the feature, e.g. `properties.parcelState`.

properties.description:
Ordered rules.
For each feature, the first rule whose `source` is the collection it came from and whose `match` (if any) applies decides how it is drawn; a feature no rule claims is not drawn.
A non-empty list replaces the built-in rules entirely.
Top-level collection of the document to classify, e.g. `solids`, `parcels`, `faces`, `rings`, or the derived `surfaces` (shells no solid uses).
Identifier grouping this rule's features, e.g. `unit`.
Groups several kinds under one heading and select-all. Defaults to `kind`.
Human-readable name for this kind, e.g. `Principal units`.

How the feature's topology is turned into a shape.
`solid`, `open-shell` and `face` are sectioned at each floor's height; `polygon` (a Polygon-topology parcel) and `ring` are drawn flat, as outlines, on every floor.

Where a feature's label comes from: the first of `properties` (dot-separated paths) that resolves to a non-empty value or to an object with a string `label`, else `fallback` (default `id`).
Omitted, the view uses appellation, description, then name.
Whether the feature is shown when the view opens. Default true.
Defaults merged under every rule; `style` is merged key by key.
Preferred order of kinds, for viewers that list them.

Dot-separated path on each solid giving the floor level number(s) it is on — a number or an array of numbers.
Default `properties.floors`.
Tab label per level, e.g. `{ "1": "Ground floor" }`. Default `Level <n>`.

Section height in metres per level, on the document's vertical datum.
Default: the mid-height of the solids listed on that level alone.
Whether lower floors are drawn, faded, under each section when the view opens. Default false.
Metres of margin around the drawing. Default 2.
`true` (default, automatic spacing), `false` (no grid), or a spacing in metres.

Ordered choices for the one boundary parcel drawn on every floor; the first entry that yields an outline wins.
Default `[{ "source": "parcels" }]` (the first parcel with an outline); `[]` draws no boundary.
Collection to choose from. Default `parcels`.

Instead of drawing the matched feature, follow its `topology.relationships` entry with this `role` to the feature its `href` names (in `source`, default the same collection), e.g. from a strata scheme to its containing primary parcel.

Solids never sectioned: every feature of `source` excludes the solid(s) whose id is the value at `property`.
Default: the geometry of every `occupationFeatures` item (walls, slabs, ceilings); `[]` excludes nothing.
